[SWS_FrSM_00176] ⌈For controlling the passive mode (receive-only), the state ma-
chine shall additionally comprise the following states which concurrent to the states
above:
• FRSM_ECU_ACTIVE
• FRSM_ECU_PASSIVE
⌋
Table 7.2 provides more information about the additional states.
FrSM additional State
Description
FRSM_ECU_ACTIVE
When the FrSM is concurrently in state FRSM_READY, the transceivers are in set
into mode FRTRCV_TRCVMODE_STANDBY, otherwise into mode FRTRCV_
TRCVMODE_NORMAL
FRSM_ECU_PASSIVE
When the FrSM is concurrently in state FRSM_READY, the transceivers are in set
into mode FRTRCV_TRCVMODE_STANDBY, otherwise into mode FRTRCV_
TRCVMODE_RECEIVEONLY.
Table 7.2: FrSM Additional States
